about: Recorded by "npm run record-runs" from the real code. Fixed clock, sequential ids, SQLite in memory. Do not edit.

R1.text: The amount is an integer number of cents, more than 0 and not more than 100 000 000.

R3.text: The date is a real calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD.

R4.text: The merchant name has 1 to 80 characters, and the request has no field that the contract does not name.

R5.text: The date of an expense is not after today.

R6.text: The category of an expense is one active category of the store.

R7.text: A second expense with the same date, amount and merchant needs a confirmation of the person.

R8.text: One request key records one expense at most.

R9.text: A category has one budget at most for a month, and the limit is more than 0.

R10.text: The spent amount of a budget is the sum of its expenses in its month. No table stores it.

R11.text: Over budget is a state of the budget. It is not a FAIL: the expense is recorded.

R12.text: A suggestion names one active category of the store, or it says UNKNOWN.

R13.text: Only an expense that the person records changes the ledger and the merchant memory. A suggestion changes nothing.

R14.text: Each line of an imported statement has exactly one end: recorded, duplicate, rejected, waiting or paired.

allowlist.name: analyse_spending
allowlist.purpose: Show where the money of one pay cycle went, for all categories or for one category.
allowlist.model_does: The model selects the pay cycle and, if the person named one, the category.
allowlist.application_does: The application reads its own ledger and calculates each total.

allowlist.name: suggest_category
allowlist.purpose: Propose a category for one merchant name.
allowlist.model_does: The model gives the merchant name that the person wrote.
allowlist.application_does: The application runs its suggest graph and shows the proposal in the form, where the person accepts or changes it.

allowlist.name: propose_column_mapping
allowlist.purpose: Propose which column of an imported statement is the date, the description and the amount.
allowlist.model_does: The model proposes a column for each meaning, a date format and a decimal mark.
allowlist.application_does: The application tries the mapping on the lines of the batch and applies it only after the person approves.

allowlist.name: recommend_allowance
allowlist.purpose: Recommend a change of the weekly allowance, as a percentage.
allowlist.model_does: The model recommends a percentage and gives a short reason.
allowlist.application_does: The application calculates the new allowance and its consequences in cents and shows them before the person approves.

rules.text: A model can request only a capability of the allowlist
The application checks each request against its own facts
A change needs the approval of the person
